why: This is a single-study cohort and data-collection design from one school, not a reusable instructional element, general method, or named dataset product.
Uro-Island is a named educational game/software product rather than a general instructional element or merely a one-setting implementation.
name: Uro-Island
product_description: Uro-Island is a Windows-based electronic adventure game developed at the University Medical Center Freiburg for teaching medical students phase-contrast microscopic urinalysis through story-driven exploration, dialogue, quests, and diagnosis.
